translation:
<ins>Blood-Invigorating Qi-Smoothing Fleeceflower Powder (活血順氣何首烏散)</ins>
Fleeceflower root (何首烏, three qian), dang gui (當歸), red peony (赤芍藥), angelica dahurica (白芷), lindera (烏藥), bitter orange (枳殼), saposhnikovia (防風), licorice (甘草), chuanxiong (川芎), tangerine peel (陳皮), cyperus (香附), perilla (紫蘇), notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), cinnamon bark (肉桂, each one qian)
Above, decoct with mint (薄荷) and raw rehmannia (生地黃), add wine and take together. If the pain is severe, add frankincense (乳香) and myrrh (沒藥). <ins>Menstruation-Regulating Powder (調經散)</ins>
Chuanxiong (川芎), dang gui (當歸), peony (芍藥), astragalus (黃耆, each one and a half qian), green tangerine peel (青皮), lindera (烏藥), tangerine peel (陳皮), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), frankincense (乳香, each one qian)
Above, make into one dose; with two cups of water, decoct to one cup, take without regard to time.
